title: The Last Ledger Revisited
author: Jonah Winterbourne
blurb: Bram Voss, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the trial begins.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
